hangzhou-39.bio: A large lake park in Xiaoshan with lakeside paths, causeways and boat rides, laid out around the old Xiang Lake.
hangzhou-39.ticket_note: Official site not found or verified; do not guess
hangzhou-39.notes: Entry fee unverified: a weekend guide lists the park as free, an older Bendibao page says 30 CNY, 2022-24 group-buy pages list 15-20 CNY. Boats, sightseeing cars and theme parks are paid extras. Needs the operator's page check; treat free as unverified.

haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.bio: Riverside park at Yanguan on the Qiantang River, where visitors watch the tidal bore roll upstream along the sea wall.
haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.ticket_note: Tickets via the Chaole Zhicheng WeChat mini-program; no website found
haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.notes: Undated guide: off-season 30 CNY, bore-season day ticket 90 CNY; under-18s and over-70s free. Ctrip shows from 30 CNY. Unverified against operator. Bore is best seen on the big-tide days around the 18th of the lunar month.

yangjiatang-village.bio: Quiet hillside village in Songyang county with Qing-dynasty houses and two roughly 500-year-old camphor trees at its entrance.
yangjiatang-village.notes: Free per Ctrip user-compiled page; village ~350 years old with little commercialisation. Not official.

quzhou-2.bio: The southern branch of the Confucius family temple in Quzhou, entered with a ticket bundled with a miniature Analects.
quzhou-2.notes: Price from Ctrip (from 10 CNY); Qunar shows from 7 CNY. Address 96 Xinqiao St, Kecheng.

wu-zixiong-glass-art-museum.bio: Small museum in Jiaojiang showing glass art by Wu Zixiong, his son and his students, on the Jiazhijing cultural corridor.
wu-zixiong-glass-art-museum.notes: 30 CNY from an undated travelogue only; may have changed or be free. Unverified.

gouqi-island.bio: Wolfberry-named island in the Shengsi archipelago with a fishing harbour, painted villages and cliff-top sunrise viewpoints.
gouqi-island.ticket_note: Part of the Shengsi Islands scenic area; no single official site verified
gouqi-island.notes: Island access is free; blogs report a 50 CNY combined ticket (Dawang Beach + East Cliff, one day) while other sights are free. Ferry fares not counted. Unverified; consider costBasis ticket 50 if confirmed.
